settings.text: One short electrolyte base, then one addition per formula. If an ingredient does not pull its weight, it does not go in.

settings.title: Name every source
settings.text: You see every ingredient with its source, like Ancient Ocean® Pink Himalayan Salt and CocOganic® Plus coconut water.

settings.title: Make it in the USA with internationally sourced ingredients
settings.text: Blended and packed in a cGMP-compliant facility in the USA, with ingredients sourced from the US and abroad.

settings.title: Print every milligram
settings.text: No proprietary blends. What you read on the front matches what you read on the back.

settings.title: You know what's in it
settings.text: Every ingredient named, with its source. No proprietary blends, ever.
